Publisher Administration

You can find some information about the publisher admin in the manual here, but it is out-of-date.

Packages: a list of all your published assets, as well as the ones pending review and the drafts you have created.

Sales: for each month, the number of time each particular assets that has been bought.

Free Downloads: for each month, the number of time each of your free assets has been downloaded.

Revenue: per month, your debit, credit and cumulative balance.

Verify Invoice: self-explanatory.

Vouchers: create voucher to give your asset for free. Publishers are able to issue 12 Free Package Vouchers per package within the last year.

Users: user accounts linked to your publisher account.

Payout: self-explanatory.

Info: information about you as a publisher. Description, support e-mail, images, ...

How is an Asset's popularity calculated

There is scarcely any information about this. By personal experience, it seems that what will bump your asset up is mainly when it is bought, rated and updated.

The number of downloads for free assets also influences its position. But popular ones are downloaded tens of time a day, so your asset needs to keep up with them before going up a position.

Communicating with your asset's reviews

Some publisher believe that they have no way to know if a review has been posted to his/her asset's page, apart from checking the page itself. Actually, there is an RSS Feed called Activity Notification that is available for all publishers in the info section of the publisher admin.

You will receive information about created and updated reviews. Remember, that you can respond to theses reviews, by logging into your publisher account in your browser (or Unity Editor's browser); in your asset's page you then will see that you have the possibility to reply to the reviews.
